summaries: A Form 10-K annual report for Arvana Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2020. Relevant to the task: It establishes the year-end 2020 share capital baseline, reporting 4,610,670 shares outstanding as of December 31, 2020, following an issuance of 3,576,640 shares to settle debt during the year. A subsequent event note discloses a March 15, 2021 increase in authorized share capital to 500,000,000 shares. The document contains no financial statements or share data for the 2021 through 2024 period, serving only as a pre-trend reference point for the collection's trend analysis.

A Form 10-K annual report for Arvana Inc. covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021. Relevant to the task: The document establishes the share capital baseline for 2021, reporting 34,148,518 shares outstanding at year-end (up from 4,610,670 in 2020). The Statement of Stockholders’ Deficiency details a major issuance of 29,537,848 shares during the year, primarily for debt settlement. This document provides the specific 2021 figure needed for the trend analysis but contains no share data for 2022, 2023, or 2024.

A Form 10-K annual report for Arvana Inc. covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task: It reports common stock outstanding as 35,948,518 shares at December 31, 2022, compared to 34,148,518 shares at December 31, 2021, detailing an issuance of 1,800,000 shares through private placement and debt settlement. The document discloses a subsequent 3-for-1 forward stock split effective April 2023. This provides the specific 2022 share capital figures necessary to trace the trend from 2021, though the numbers reflect the pre-split capital structure.

A Form 10-K annual report for Arvana Inc. covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: It provides the share capital data for 2023 and an update for early 2024, reporting 107,845,554 shares issued and 107,839,299 outstanding as of December 31, 2023, consistent with the 2022 year-end figures due to no new issuances during the year. The document explicitly notes a 3-for-1 forward stock split effective April 2023 with retroactive application, ensuring comparability with prior years' share counts. Additionally, the cover page discloses 107,845,554 shares outstanding as of April 5, 2024, supplying the final data point required to establish the share capital trend from 2021 through 2024 when combined with previous filings.
